title: 美联储高管直言：别管银行怎么用AI，银行自己最懂风险
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: As bank regulators and supervisors, the Federal Reserve has a role to play in encouraging responsible innovation while maintaining a safe and sound banking system. But it is important
segments.zh: 作为银行监管机构，美联储在鼓励负责任创新的同时维护银行体系安全稳健方面发挥作用。但重要的是要明确这一角色的边界。

segments.en: to be clear about what that role is and what it is not. We can create a supportive regulatory
segments.zh: 我们可以通过接纳新思想和技术来营造支持性的监管环境，并明确我们的期望。

segments.en: environment by being receptive to new ideas and technologies. We can provide clarity on our expectations. But ultimately, the decision of when and how to innovate rests with each bank
segments.zh: 但最终，何时以及如何创新的决定权在于每家银行及其管理层。他们比我们更了解自己的客户、社区和风险偏好。

segments.en: and its management. They know their customers and their communities and their risk appetite better than we do. Our job is to set clear expectations to be transparent and not to micromanage
segments.zh: 我们的工作是设定清晰的期望，保持透明，而不是微观管理具体的商业决策。
